idea: A booking website for our 12 yoga studios: members book classes, buy passes and get e-mail and SMS reminders. A web agency quotes 38,000 EUR: is it consistent, and what is missing?
interviewAnswers: Around 20,000 EUR to build and at most 400 EUR a month to run.
We must launch before September. Member data must stay in the EU.
SMS reminders are a must. Nobody technical in-house: the agency would maintain it.
debateAnswers: The agency maintains it; we want to be free to change provider later.
